description: This file defines the CustomerOptionValueDao interface, which extends the generic SalesManagerEntityDao and declares data access methods specifically for CustomerOptionValue entities, including listing by store and language, and fetching by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to CustomerOptionValue entities, extending general entity DAO functionality.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue instances filtered by merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a specific CustomerOptionValue based on store and a string code.
